original_test_intent: Verify the correct onboard BMC heartbeat LED visibly indicates normal BMC operation at the specified power/readiness state using the approved color and temporal pattern.
original_method: Identify board revision and LED designator/location; place system in the specified AC/host/BMC readiness state; qualified observer records a timestamped video long enough to measure color, on/off cadence and stability; correlate with BMC readiness/logs and compare to the approved specification without treating software health as a visual substitute.
manual_activity: Qualified observer safely identifies and records the physical LED; agent may timestamp and correlate BMC readiness/log evidence.
required_inputs: Board revision and exact heartbeat LED designator/location
Expected color, solid/blink pattern, frequency/duty tolerance and observation duration
safety_requirements: Use safe ESD/guarded access; do not touch energized internals
Confirm exact LED and SUT identity in evidence
Observe long enough for cadence measurement under stable state
Do not infer physical output from logs alone or clear baseline logs
agent_execution_scope: Collect BMC readiness and log correlation and analyze timestamped video if supplied
Do not open chassis, approach hazardous energized parts, claim visual state without evidence or decide verdict
engineer_actions: Approve LED map and operating-state/cadence specification
Approve safe observation setup and tolerance
Review physical and correlated evidence and decide verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No remote command proves physical color/cadence; logs are supplemental only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a timestamped, SUT-identified video and objective frame timing, correlated with BMC readiness.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Power-on and specification-matching heartbeat observation remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Measure the named LED's visible color and cadence from timestamped video in the exact readiness state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds designator, state, duration, cadence tolerance and evidence traceability.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: BMC ping/health cannot substitute for a failed or miswired physical indicator.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Camera exposure/flicker can alias blink frequency; observation duration/frame rate must support the tolerance.

project_override_considerations: If the LED is hidden by an installed cover, use only an approved safe observation fixture; do not remove guarding while energized without the hardware procedure.
expected_evidence: SUT-linked photo/video showing color and measured cadence
Supplemental BMC health/logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, procedure and Criteria consistently request a specification-based physical heartbeat LED check.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This remains a valid manual test; unavailable specification or safe visibility blocks execution only until supplied.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2262 Wistron-HW-00167-V004: approve board revision and exact BMC heartbeat LED designator/location; required AC/host/BMC readiness state; expected color, solid/blink pattern, frequency/duty tolerance and observation duration; approve safe visibility/recording setup and whether any software/BMC signal is supplemental correlation only.

review_improvement: Preserves physical observation while making 'works normally' an objective, traceable color-and-cadence measurement.
independent_technical_reasoning: A heartbeat LED usually reflects a firmware GPIO/timer and can fail independently of network responsiveness. Conversely a blinking nearby status LED can be mistaken for it. Correct verification therefore depends on board-specific designator, system state and temporal measurement. Because the physical light is the required output, remote logs cannot replace the observer, though they can correlate readiness and faults.
